digest.component_or_area: plan review gate, T5c security criterion
propositions: T5c rubric must ground security evaluation in the current codebase and configuration via read tools, with a criterion-local override to the shared preamble's as-written stance, so that existing controls flip findings
T5c must emit at most one undeclared-access-posture finding per plan, folding additional surfaces into that single finding's evidence rather than creating separate findings per surface
T5c candidate findings that cite neither read repo artifacts nor quoted plan sentences must be demoted to minor severity, never suppressed, preserving blocking capability for grounded findings

T5c blocking posture changes from advisory at 0.95 to blocking at 0.90, enabled only for findings in two HIGH classes: plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces
All previously pinned trust-boundary phrases and scoping rules in plan_review_T5c.md must remain intact through the rewrite
Pinned blocking-set assertions in three test modules (test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_criteria_blocking.py) must include T5c with the new routing configuration
